text:
maya: Quick flag — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1867 updates the Optimize toolkit prefetch example. It changes the `kv_prefetch=True` example and adds a quant profile note. Can someone sanity-check? :eyes:
chris: I skimmed — main concern is the Python snippet uses `batch_size=32` which could blow latency for short-sequence workloads. Suggest adding a short-seq warning and a recommended default of 4-8.
sarah: Agreed. Also the quant profile section currently suggests 'int4' as first choice. For most customers we recommend `int8` fallback if accuracy drops — add wording and a tiny example config.
diego: Leaving a quick SDK nit: the snippet imports `redwood.optimize` but we recently renamed to `redwood.optimizekit` in the SDK. That will break the example for anyone copying it. PR should either update imports or pin a comment about SDK version.
maya: Good catches. I'll update the PR but want concrete wording. Proposed bullets to add to docs (short copy):
- "Start with batch_size=4 for short / latency-sensitive routes; scale up only if per-token latency target allows."
- "Prefer int8 quant profiles for general workloads; use int4 for cost-sensitive workloads after eval. See eval checklist below."
chris: That reads well. Also add a one-line code example for a short sequence workload: 
```python
from redwood.optimizekit import PrefetchConfig
cfg = PrefetchConfig(kv_prefetch=True, batch_size=4, prefetch_prefill=8)
client.optimize.apply(cfg)
```
sarah: Add a note about deterministic fallback: "If accuracy regresses >2% on your smoke eval, fallback to `int8` and re-run the eval." Maybe link to policy: https://internal.redwood/docs/evals/fallbacks (use relative link).
amanda-docs-bot: Automated checklist: docs PR must include (1) updated snippet, (2) example outputs for short/long seq, (3) quant profile caveats. Running linkcheck.
diego: For linkcheck — the PR currently references `optimize/kv-prefetch.md` but the canonical path is `optimizekit/prefetch.md`. Fix path and add redirect.
maya: I'll patch the PR now: updating import path, adding the short-seq snippet, the int8 note, and correcting links. Leaving a TODO to request eng-ml review for the quant wording. Thanks! :thumbsup:
chris: ping me when updated, I'll do a quick read + lgtm if all good.
sarah: I can validate the accuracy wording after eng-ml review.
amanda-docs-bot: Linkcheck complete — flagged one broken internal link (will show in PR comments).
